label: Riemann Hypothesis main statements
gloss: Top-level statements of the Riemann Hypothesis and nonvanishing of Dirichlet L-functions, stated for Lean.

label: Build helper declarations
gloss: Build-support code that registers name filters and lists the theory namespaces for the other directories.

label: Bessel orbit bounds
gloss: Bounds on Bessel-type functionals and orbit maps for matrix groups, written as Lean lemmas on norms, derivatives and integrability.

label: Smoothness of Bessel functions
gloss: Smoothness properties of Bessel-type functions built from nilpotent matrix algebras and polynomial rings.

label: Wave grids for Bessel bounds
gloss: Grid estimates for Bessel-type wave functions, covering step sizes, coefficient bounds and lattice norms.

label: Normal form domination on compacts
gloss: Normal-form dominations and square integrability for Jacobi-type fields on compact sets, as Lean lemmas.

label: Discrete group wave estimates
gloss: Integrability and sum estimates for wave-type functions indexed by discrete groups, written as Lean lemmas.

label: Harish-Chandra multiplicity
gloss: Defines a Harish-Chandra multiplicity from unitary matrices and projections onto finite-dimensional subspaces.

label: Hecke standard modules
gloss: Standard modules for Hecke algebras attached to number fields, built from double cosets, ideals and valuation subrings.

label: Jacobi diagonal normal forms
gloss: Normal-form relations and diagonal bounds for Jacobi-type matrix words in a star ring, written as Lean definitions.

label: K-finite vectors and decay
gloss: Shows that certain vectors are K-finite under unitary groups, with a decay bound for the sN quantity.

label: Krull dimension of models
gloss: Shows that the Krull dimension of a model equals its transcendence degree, using finite type algebras and schemes.

label: Local Bessel uniqueness
gloss: Uniqueness of local Bessel functionals and multiplicity one for unitary branching, as Lean declarations.

label: Mirabolic restriction of representations
gloss: Restricts representations of general linear groups to the mirabolic subgroup and checks which induced pieces are irreducible.

label: Tied normal form models
gloss: Model points and gauge generators for tied normal forms, with a Haar measure finiteness fact and related norm identities.

label: Galois cohomology of p-adic fields
gloss: Computes Galois cohomology groups of p-adic cyclotomic fields, including Tate duality, cup products and Euler characteristics.

label: p-adic unitary weights
gloss: Unit parts and unitary weight decompositions for p-adic groups, linked to Weil-Deligne representations and Siegel sets.

label: Pieri rules for representations
gloss: Pieri-type decomposition rules for tensor products of representations, with Bessel norm and Gram identities in Lean.

label: Separation of places in extensions
gloss: Shows that places of a number field can be separated by abelian Galois elements, using idele class groups and Artin maps.

label: Grothendieck group of representations
gloss: Grothendieck-group identities for irreducible admissible representations of GL-type groups, organised around segment and multisegment combinatorics.

label: Rank one estimates
gloss: Estimates for rank-one reductions of integrals, with Haar measure scaling and integrability lemmas.

label: Rank one torus bounds
gloss: Bounds for rank-one torus integrals involving Haar measure, Weyl group facts and Bessel functions.

label: Schur orthogonality limit bounds
gloss: Limit bounds on matrix coefficients of unitary representations, using Schur orthogonality and Harish-Chandra parameters.

label: Segment representations of GL_n
gloss: Constructs segment representations of general linear groups and checks their Whittaker and Jacquet-Shalika properties.

label: Siegel mass and unit volumes
gloss: Volume and mass formulas for unit groups of CM fields and Hermitian lattices, following a Siegel-type formula.

label: Siegel-Weil formula finiteness
gloss: Shows that the Siegel-Weil integral is finite on a fundamental domain for Hermitian forms over number fields.

label: Tempered local representations
gloss: Tempered local representations, classified through Bernstein-Zelevinsky data and obstruction lifts.

label: Theta series dilations
gloss: Dilation and Fourier identities for theta-type functions built from the Heisenberg group and number field data.

label: Uniform local Bessel formulas
gloss: Uniform local formulas and energy bounds for restrictions of Bessel-type integrals, with discriminant-dependent constants.

label: Unitriangular Haar measure
gloss: Measure-preserving maps on adele coordinates, where unitriangular matrices act by vector multiplication, with elliptic torus norms.

label: Zuckerman functor commutation
gloss: Commutation rules between Zuckerman functors and Capelli operators for Harish-Chandra parameters, as Lean lemmas.

label: Newforms and adjoint transfer
gloss: Import-heavy directory on newforms, Frobenius power compatibility and adjoint transfer for automorphic forms.

label: Zero-level Langlands imports
gloss: Import hub for a zero-level layer that contains the local Langlands subfolder.

label: Bessel parameter integrals
gloss: Convergence and smoothness of Bessel-type integrals indexed by Harish-Chandra parameters, with unitary group matrices.

label: K-finite analytic vectors
gloss: Analytic and smooth vectors that are K-finite, for Harish-Chandra modules and unitary matrix groups.

label: Low K-type multiplicity
gloss: Counts multiplicities of low K-types in discrete series representations, using weight spaces and Casimir elements.

label: Nonempty highest-weight representations
gloss: Shows that highest-weight representations of the relevant data types exist, with matrix exponential and derivative lemmas.

label: Base change for real groups
gloss: Base change of representations along CM field extensions, with quadratic splitting and count lemmas.

label: Discrete series representations
gloss: Builds discrete series representations of real groups on L2 spaces and classifies them by simple scalar characters.

label: Formal degrees of real groups
gloss: Computes formal degrees of discrete series representations of real groups, using positive definite matrices and norm bounds.

label: Unitary representations of GL_n
gloss: Studies irreducible unitary representations of general linear groups, including segment, Whittaker and induced constructions.

label: Unitary admissibility of representations
gloss: Tests when representations of real groups are unitary and admissible, using Hermitian lattices and Cartan involutions.

label: Counting function definitions
gloss: Definitions for counting functions of lattice points and Euler products over number fields, used by later proofs.

label: Local-global lattice arguments
gloss: Large set of proofs about lattices, Gram forms and Haar measures, with a pigeonhole argument on lattice points.

label: Inner product factorization
gloss: Factorises inner products of Schwartz functions via the Fourier transform and a metaplectic-type exponential.

label: Lie group reduction for thickenings
gloss: Reduces estimates on thickened Lie groups to Siegel-domain and metaplectic block computations, with derivative lemmas.

label: Siegel domain estimates
gloss: Estimates on fundamental domains of Hermitian forms and cones, used for bounding square-integrable Weil-range functions.

label: Abelian variety block theory
gloss: Block-structured lemmas on abelian schemes, polarisations, jets and levels for CM and Hecke-type data.

label: Counterexamples for abelian varieties
gloss: Lean files that construct counterexamples to candidate lemmas about abelian varieties, biextensions and heights.

label: Crystalline period rings
gloss: Maps between crystalline period rings, such as Acris and Bcris, built on Witt vectors and logarithms.

label: Abelian variety definitions
gloss: Core definitions for abelian varieties, divisors, lattices and schemes, which other directories in this area import.

label: Abelian scheme lemma library
gloss: Proofs of lemmas about abelian schemes, divisors and etale cohomology, far too many to read individually.

label: Published theorems on abelian varieties
gloss: Statements of theorems taken from the literature on abelian varieties, Hodge theory and automorphic forms, stated for Lean.

label: Abelian scheme and theta statements
gloss: Statement files for abelian schemes, fundamental domains, Hecke theta integrals and local trivialisations, without full proofs.

label: Adelic gluing of local integrals
gloss: Glues local integrals over places into adelic statements, using Iwahori subgroups, compact supports and coset spaces.

label: Adelic quotients and Euler products
gloss: Bounds on adelic quotients of GL_n, including Euler product factorisations, compact norms and height estimates.

label: Adelic SL2 fundamental domains
gloss: Describes fundamental domains and Haar measures for adelic SL2, relating ideles, rational points and descent to SL2.

label: Automorphic forms and Galois representations
gloss: Large body of lemmas on automorphic forms, Galois representations and strong multiplicity one, with local and global arguments.

label: Bloch-Kato extensions
gloss: Prunes and extends Bloch-Kato style crystalline extension data for p-adic representations, using weakly admissible filtrations.

label: Blow-up categories
gloss: Defines blow-up-style categories of commutative rings and affine schemes, with morphisms and monoid structures.

label: CM trace embeddings
gloss: Shows that trace maps from CM fields are injective and embed trace forms into real tensor products, using linear equivalences.

label: CM trace form decomposition
gloss: Decomposes trace forms of CM fields over split places and bounds discriminants via idempotents and logarithms.

label: Character box bounds
gloss: Covers Dirichlet characters of bounded conductor, choosing box shapes and bounding divisors for each character.

label: Commutative algebra and cohomology
gloss: Commutative algebra and sheaf cohomology lemmas for schemes, including etale cohomology, cochain complexes and Picard groups.

label: Conductors and Kronecker symbols
gloss: Shows conductor and Kronecker symbol facts for characters, including sign and inertia computations at primes.

label: Coprime ranks of characters
gloss: Counts admissible ranks and character classes for CM data, using Frobenius orbits and unit maps mod n.

label: Crystalline period rings
gloss: Defines the Ainf and Acris period rings for crystalline comparison, with Teichmuller-style structure lemmas.

label: Cup product pullbacks
gloss: Pullback and cup-product facts for Cech cochains, with simplicial categories and unimodular rows.

label: Cyclotomic field bounds
gloss: Bounds for cyclotomic fields, covering roots of unity, ramified discriminants, class number and norm sums.

label: Landau zero-free region
gloss: Landau-type zero-free region and pole estimates for Dirichlet L-functions, with Mellin transforms and Gamma functions.

label: Divisor frames on schemes
gloss: Frames and divisor data on schemes and lattices, with Cartier divisors and Hecke frame coefficients.

label: Etale idempotents and crystalline comparison
gloss: Builds orthogonal idempotents for etale algebras and uses them in crystalline comparison lemmas.

label: Even character boxes
gloss: Single file on boxes for even characters, relating Kronecker and Jacobi symbols and bounding box sizes.

label: Exponential growth bounds
gloss: Single file of inequalities for exponentials, logarithms and real powers, used in bad-share counting.

label: Automorphic foundations library
gloss: Foundational lemmas for automorphic and Galois arguments, including convolution operators and Siegel-Weil-type formulas.

label: Frobenius orbits and localisation
gloss: Localises Frobenius and ramification data at primes, with norm bounds, unit groups and residue degree sums.

label: Frobenius-twisted norms
gloss: Constructs Frobenius-twisted norms on adjoined-root extensions and shows they divide polynomial differences.

label: Generic germ injectivity
gloss: Shows that generic germs in Cech and de Rham cohomology of schemes are injective, using affine covers.

label: Idele lattice facts
gloss: Facts about lattices in ideles, including determinant comparison at split places and local lattice existence.

label: Integral casts in p-adic rings
gloss: Large collection of integral structure facts for p-adic period rings and completions, with Acris and Ainf lemmas.

label: Iwahori subgroup commensurability
gloss: Shows Iwahori subgroups are commensurated in GL_n, using affine Weyl group reflections and double cosets.

label: Kahler differential vanishing
gloss: Shows Kahler differentials vanish for formally etale algebras, using trivial square-zero extensions and derivations.

label: Local charts and embeddings
gloss: Local charts and fundamental-domain covers for schemes and lattices, with cocycle and embedding statements.

label: Local test functions for adeles
gloss: Constructs local test functions on adelic GL_n and proves their integrals factor over places.

label: Lying-over and glueing over places
gloss: Splits integrals over places above a number field using lying-over and finite product splittings.

label: Mean square character bounds
gloss: Mean-square bounds for Dirichlet characters and sums of von Mangoldt weights over prime powers, in Lean.

label: Natural divisibility of places
gloss: Shows natural divisibility of ramification and inertia degrees at places over a number field, using p-adic completions.

label: Orbit labellings at inert primes
gloss: Labels orbits of inert primes by row data and conjugate partition shapes, with power series bounds on formal sums.

label: p-adic lattice approximation
gloss: Approximates lattices and Hermitian forms p-adically, with isogenies and denominators controlled for adelic endomorphisms.

label: Prime discriminants of hosts
gloss: Chooses prime sets and discriminant-dividing hosts for number fields, using primitive roots and torsion orders.

label: Primitive cosets of characters
gloss: Counts primitive characters through coset decompositions and weighted-mean bounds for L-function chains.

label: Quadratic characters and cyclotomic fields
gloss: Builds quadratic characters and Gauss sum roots for real cyclotomic subgroups, with bounds on characters in mean square.

label: Real span data for uniformization
gloss: Real span and uniformization data for complex abelian varieties, using lattices, link and datum structures.

label: Representation rank of schemes
gloss: Defines the representation rank of an over-scheme and its projection, and proves closed-set facts about it.
